descriptionChirho: Piel active: to call someone blessed, to declare happy or fortunate, to congratulate as favored.
Pual passive: to be pronounced blessed or happy, to be declared fortunate by others.
Piel active: to lead, guide, or direct someone along a path or course of action.
Pual passive: to be led, guided, or directed by another along a path.
To go straight, walk forward, or proceed along a path, used in both Piel and Qal stems.
Piel: to set right, correct, or reprove someone, restoring them to the proper course.
